---
title: "Getting started"
---

## Install

```bash
R CMD INSTALL rsdocs_0.1.0.tar.gz          # just for you
sudo R CMD INSTALL rsdocs_0.1.0.tar.gz     # for all users (site library)
```

Restart the R session afterwards.

## Open the docs

Use **Addins -> Docs**, or from the console:

```r
rsdocs::rsdocs()       # open in the viewer pane
rsdocs::rsdocs_stop()  # stop the docs server
```
